Cost of saving Whyalla steel plant reaches $4m a worker

Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 0:45
Instaread
Grace LaganEconomics reporter
Sep 15, 2026 – 6.08pm
 or Subscribe to save article
EmailLinkedInTwitterFacebook

Subscribe now

Already a subscriber?

 or Subscribe to comment

The shuttering of the Whyalla steelworks’ blast furnace has blown out the cost the plant’s bailout to $4 million per job, prompting calls from economists for clearer and more stringent criteria for government interventions in blue-collar industries.

Up to 600 workers at the Whyalla steelworks will be made redundant after administrator KordaMentha and the South Australian government abandoned attempts to restart the blast furnace, which has been beset by technical problems and not operated since April.
